title: Integration Test Engineer II/III- Clean Energy

cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for an Integration Test Engineer to join our team.
As part of the integration testing team you will work closely with both firmware and hardware to test new features, identify bugs and ultimately improve product performance at a low level. The candidate will be a communicative and detail-oriented engineer with a passion for embedded systems and/or power electronics.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Design, execute and automate tests on embedded power electronics systems. Identify root cause of test and hardware failures. Expand coverage at the unit and system testing levels. Debug embedded firmware written in C. Document and clearly communicate testing outcomes to various teams. Instrument and collect direct measurements from systems using various lab equipment (oscilloscopes, data loggers and power analyzers). Participate in code reviews and design decisions for next generation products.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field
At least 2 years of relevant work experience
Familiarity with electrical test equipment (oscilloscopes, meters, and power supplies)
Proficiency in Python or similar language
Embedded C development experience
Unix familiarity and embedded systems
Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to a variety of audiences
Preferred Requirements
Experience in test automation
Proactive and positive when taking on challenging tasks, owning assignments and collaborating with other groups
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0270.intro:
We are looking for an Integration Test Engineer to join our team. You will work alongside a team of knowledgeable and collaborative engineers, helping to develop next generation power systems. Together, the team works to solve challenging problems that unlock residential PV and energy storage systems at mass scale.
As part of the integration testing team, you will work closely with firmware and hardware colleagues to test new features, identify bugs, and help improve product performance at a low level. We are looking for a communicative and detail-oriented engineer with experience in embedded systems and/or power electronics.
cond_0270.responsibilities:
Design, execute, and coordinate automated tests on embedded power electronics systems.
Work with the team to identify root causes of test and hardware failures.
Collaborate to expand coverage at the unit and system testing levels.
Help debug embedded firmware written in C.
Document and clearly communicate testing outcomes to various teams.
Instrument and collect direct measurements from systems using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, data loggers, and power analyzers).
Participate in code reviews and design discussions for next generation products.
cond_0270.requirements:
BS in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field.
At least 2 years of relevant work experience.
Familiarity with electrical test equipment (oscilloscopes, meters, and power supplies).
Experience in test automation.
Proficiency in Python or similar language.
Embedded C development experience.
Unix familiarity and embedded systems.
Proactive and positive when taking on challenging tasks, owning assignments and collaborating with other groups.
Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to a variety of audiences.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear, and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. As part of the integration testing team, you will coordinate with firmware and hardware engineers to test new features, identify bugs, and improve product performance at a low level.
cond_0403.responsibilities:
Design, execute, and automate tests on embedded power electronics systems.
Identify root cause of test and hardware failures.
Expand coverage at the unit and system testing levels.
Debug embedded firmware written in C.
Document testing outcomes and share results with relevant teams.
Instrument and collect direct measurements from systems using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, data loggers, and power analyzers).
Provide input to code reviews and design decisions for next-generation products.

BS in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
At least 2 years of relevant work experience.
Familiarity with electrical test equipment (oscilloscopes, meters, and power supplies).
Experience in test automation.
Proficiency in Python or similar language.
Embedded C development experience.
Unix familiarity and embedded systems knowledge.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and directly in written and verbal form.
Detail-oriented with a methodical approach to owning assignments and working through challenging tasks.
Comfortable coordinating with other groups as needed to complete work.

The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend, or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift loads as large as 25 pounds.
